findings.message: Registry URI whose CTID portion is a bare UUID: the ce- prefix is missing. Expected: ce- followed by a UUID v4 in 8-4-4-4-12 form, 39 characters, lower case hexadecimal, e.g. ce-e8a41a52-6ff6-48f0-9872-889c87b093b7.

rule.citation: About the CTID, section "CTID-Based URI Structure": Registry URIs are constructed from https://credentialengineregistry.org plus /resources/ or /graph/ plus the CTID itself, and "the value of a resource's CTID property will exactly match the CTID portion of that resource's URI".

findings.message: Bare UUID where a CTID belongs: the ce- prefix is missing. Expected grammar: ce- followed by a UUID v4 in 8-4-4-4-12 form, 39 characters, lower case hexadecimal, e.g. ce-e8a41a52-6ff6-48f0-9872-889c87b093b7.

rule.citation: About the CTID, section "CTID Structure": "Each CTID is made up of a standard UUID v4 prefixed with ce-" for "a total of 39 characters (34 hexadecimal characters and 5 hyphens)", in the form ce- plus 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal digits. Example given: ce-e8a41a52-6ff6-48f0-9872-889c87b093b7.
